funding.name: Minnesota Dual-Training Pipeline (Dual Training Grants)
funding.provider: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry; grants administered by Minnesota Office of Higher Education (OHE)
funding.provides: Supports employers in creating or enhancing competency-based, earn-and-learn dual training, where workers receive a combination of related instruction and on-the-job training. Dual Training Grants cover employee tuition, fees and materials for related instruction, plus dual-trainee supports.
funding.eligibility: Trainee must be employed by the participating employer and receive structured on-the-job training and technical instruction under the competency standards for a specific occupation. Grants apply to occupations with competency standards in seven industries: advanced manufacturing, agriculture, child care, health care services, information technology, legal cannabis industry, and transportation. Employer must have an agreement with a training provider leading to an industry-recognized degree, certificate or credential.
funding.how_to_apply: Most up-to-date grant application materials are available from the Minnesota Office of Higher Education (OHE). Questions: PIPELINE.Program@state.mn.us.
